    • sends

      public ProcessDefinition.Builder sends(Channel<?,?>... channels)
      Declares the channels this process may send on. Repeats of the same channel are ignored; the same topic through a different Channel instance is refused, because two instances for one topic leave it ambiguous which declared serdes the emissions on that topic carry.

      The whole argument list is validated before any of it is committed, so a refused call leaves the builder exactly as it was.

      Parameters:
      channels - the channels to declare
      Returns:
      this builder
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if channels or an element is null, or a topic is declared through two different Channel instances
